mapper.sql:
( SELECT A.REQ_ID AS reqId , A.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , A.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.START_DATE AS startDate , A.START_TIME AS startTime , A.END_DATE AS endDate , A.END_TIME AS endTime , A.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , A.LEAVE_DAYS AS leaveDays , A.SCH_CD AS schCd , A.PROCESS_COMMENT AS processComment , A.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.REQ_TYPE IN ('01','02','03','04','05','06','10')
UNION ALL
SELECT R.CHANGE_REQ_ID AS reqId , (CASE R.REQ_TYPE WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'LC_MOVE' ELSE 'LC_DELETE' END) AS reqType , (CASE R.REQ_STATUS WHEN 'AGREED' THEN '01' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '02' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '03' ELSE '01' END) AS reqStatus , R.MOVE_TARGET_DATE AS workYmd , LU.START_DATE AS startDate , NULL AS startTime , NULL AS endDate , NULL AS endTime , NULL AS leaveType , NULL AS leaveDays , NULL AS schCd , R.REJECT_REASON AS processComment , R.CONFIRM_DATE AS processDate , R.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_LEAVE_CHANGE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE LU ON LU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND LU.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND R.TARGET_USER_CD = #{userCd} AND R.INITIATOR_TYPE = 'WORKER' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ) U
mapper.select: /* AppReq06Mapper.selectSystValDLabels */ SELECT SYST_VAL_D_CD AS k , SYST_VAL_D_NM AS v FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D WHERE SYST_VAL_CD = #{systValCd} AND IFNULL(USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y'
